title: Conventional technique expansion
summary: dev7 broadens the pure-ooRexx reference catalogue with binary logistic regression, Gaussian Naive Bayes, deterministic Gini decision trees, deterministic k-means and PCA while preserving MLDriveableObject history semantics.
authority: Executable dev7 source/tests are authoritative; this sphere preserves architectural intent and continuation knowledge.
invariants: Every fitted estimator/transform is a driveable historical object; fit state can be rolled backward, rolled forward and branched.
Pure ooRexx is the semantic/reference path; native/NumPy/Torch acceleration must preserve state/provenance/history semantics and declared numerical policy.
Binary logistic probability meaning must not silently depend on arbitrary label ordering when the caller supplies a positive label.
Unsupervised transforms still consume provenance-bearing MLDataset objects so sample identity survives feature-space changes.
Deterministic k-means intentionally has no hidden RNG state; identical input and policy replay identically.
procedure: For two-class probabilistic classification use MLBinaryLogisticRegression and supply the positive label when probability semantics matter.
For conditionally independent continuous features use MLGaussianNaiveBayes; prediction uses log-score ordering and a variance floor.
For interpretable numeric partitioning use MLDecisionTreeClassifier and branch maxDepth/minSamplesSplit/minGain policy rather than overwriting a fitted future.
For unsupervised compact partitioning use MLKMeans; its maximin initialisation is deterministic.
For linear dimensionality reduction use MLPrincipalComponentAnalysis; transformed datasets preserve sample ids and derive PCA provenance.
Validate model futures against held-out evidence before promotion; technique breadth does not relax leakage/domain barriers.

provenance.claim: 34-test, rexxc and SSC sourceLevel-8 qualification summary.
